name: Patient Review
text: I had extreme difficulty in my shoulder since many years. I consulted Dr Swagat Shah at DHS Multispecialty Hospital for my shoulder and he suggested Shoulder replacement. After the surgery, I was able to regain all the movement of my shoulder. The hospital is extremely clean with all facilities. I was able to do both Xray and CT scan in hospital itself. The canteen food was even tastier than my home. Thank you DHS Multispecialty Hospital for making my life pain free.

name: Patient Review
text: My mother had severe chest pain and we brought her to DHS Multispecialty Hospital at midnight. She was admitted to ICU and was critical. The doctors team put all our fears at ease. She was admitted for 5 days and we brought her back completely healthy. All services at DHS Multispecialty Hospital are excellent. The hospital has state of the art ICU and private rooms. The place is very neat, hygienic and well maintained. I have witnessed their motto 'Where care meets comfort' with my personal experience.

name: Patient Review
text: As they say, care meets comfort. DHS Multispecialty Hospital is a savior. Both parents had surgeries back to back. I Consulted Dr Hardik, and he stood by me throughout this journey. He aligned the best doctor in town and suggested every next steps. Hospital Facilities are great, easy to access, most important very clean. Reception, Nursing staff, house keeping staff, canteen people, admin department are soft spoken. Their care gives you comfort. Food is very hygienic. Overall very satisfied.

name: Patient Review
text: I am immensely grateful to Dr. Hardik Shah, Dr Swagat Shah and the entire surgical team for their outstanding care during my grandfather's hip ball replacement surgery. At 89 years old, we were concerned about the risks, but doctors put our minds at ease. The surgery was a resounding success, and my grandfather is now on the road to recovery with significantly less pain and improved mobility. I highly recommend DHS for anyone in need of orthopedic surgery.
